task_description:
# Task

Predict the violation_type.

# Metric

accuracy

# Dataset

Classification task (12001 training rows, 42 feature columns). train.csv has the features and the 'violation_type' column; test.csv has the features only.

Multi-class (4 classes, heavily imbalanced tail). 40+ mixed columns: dirty free text, dates, times, lat/long, many binary Yes/No flags. The widest feature space of any staged task.

vectorizer__numeric:
KBinsDiscretizer(encode=choose_from(['onehot', 'ordinal'], name='vectorizer__...tizer__encode'),
                 n_bins=choose_int(5, 50, name='vectorizer__...tizer__n_bins'),
                 random_state=42,
                 strategy=choose_from(['quantile', 'uniform', 'kmeans'], name='vectorizer__...zer__strategy'))
feature_eng:
PolynomialFeatures(degree=choose_int(2, 3, name='feature_eng_...tures__degree'),
                   include_bias=False,
                   interaction_only=choose_from([True, False], name='feature_eng_...eraction_only'))

PCA(n_components=choose_float(0.5, 0.99, name='feature_eng_..._n_components'),
    random_state=42,
    whiten=choose_from([False, True], name='feature_eng__PCA__whiten'))

injected_options:
vectorizer__numeric:KBinsDiscretizer(encode=choose_from(['onehot', 'ordinal'], name='vectorizer__...tizer__encode'),
                 n_bins=choose_int(5, 50, name='vectorizer__...tizer__n_bins'),
                 random_state=42,
                 strategy=choose_from(['quantile', 'uniform', 'kmeans'], name='vectorizer__...zer__strategy'))
